notes: §2002:7.1.2.2 SR1 permits COPY anywhere a character-string or separator may appear, source and library text, debugging lines included (§2002:6.2.7 processes COPY before a debugging line becomes a comment), and forbids COPY within COPY; at --std 2002 the mid-statement, parenthesised, D-line, >>D-line and nested COPYs expand as derived (MID, 1, FROMLIB, FROMLIT, OUTER-LIB, INNER-LIB; no-mode MAIN, NEW, END) and a COPY inside pseudo-text-2 draws COBOL2451.
